description: Write the current drawing to a file, or return it as base64. Formats: STP (STEP, exact geometry), STL (triangles), GLB (binary glTF: triangles with colours, for 3D viewers and the web), OFB (ClassCAD's own format: the model with its features, to open again in ClassCAD or Buerligons), JSON. With `path` the file is written to disk and only its path and size come back — the way to hand the user a model (give them the path); without it the content is returned base64-encoded, which is large. The user can also save the model themselves from what `view` opens.

analytic.description: STP only: write planes, cylinders, cones, spheres and tori as such instead of as B-spline surfaces. Other CAD systems read such a file faster and recognise its holes and flats.

drawing.description: The drawing this call works on. "new" opens a new, empty drawing, and the answer names its id; from then on pass that id (e.g. "d-k3v9q2xa") in every call of this conversation about that model. A drawing belongs to the conversation that opened it: no other conversation can see or change it.

path.description: Absolute file path to write, e.g. /Users/me/Desktop/flange.stp (folders are created). Omit to get the content back as base64.

name: save
title: Save drawing
